qsm-memory save.description: Save one Claude Code main transcript into the archive (what a person and the model said, as text; idempotent), or --catch-up every main transcript the archive lacks; a subagent transcript or one nobody typed in is skipped; --detach does it in a background process and returns at once

args.name: transcript
args.description: path to a .jsonl transcript

args.name: catchUp
args.description: save every transcript under Claude Code's projects dir the archive lacks or has an older copy of, at most 20

args.name: cwd
args.description: the working directory when the transcript names none

args.name: detach
args.description: run the save in a detached qsm-memory process and return at once; its outcome is appended to save.log beside the archive

qsm-memory search.description: Full-text search over what was said in every saved session on this machine; prints hit lines or 'no session matches'

args.name: query
args.description: the search words; prefix and stem matching

args.name: limit
args.description: max hits (default 10)

args.name: since
args.description: 7d, or an ISO date: sessions that ended after it

args.name: project
args.description: only sessions of this project root

qsm-memory show.description: Print one saved session's text turns; --full reads the transcript file on disk instead (tool calls and results too), and says so when the file is gone; --lines a-b windows by turn

args.name: session
args.description: a session id or its prefix

args.name: full
args.description: read the transcript file on disk: tool calls and tool results too

args.name: lines
args.description: a-b, the turn window

qsm-memory list.description: One line per saved session, newest first: date, project, id, turns, title; --unsaved names transcripts on disk the archive lacks

args.name: since
args.description: 7d, or an ISO date

args.name: project
args.description: only sessions of this project root

args.name: unsaved
args.description: transcripts the archive lacks or has an older copy of; saves nothing

qsm-memory blob put.description: Store a file's bytes in the blob store beside the archive, named by their sha256, owner-only; prints the sha256 and the stored path; the same bytes a second time store nothing

args.name: file
args.description: the file to store

qsm-memory blob path.description: Print the path of a stored blob; missing when the archive has no blob with that sha256

args.name: sha256
args.description: the 64 hex characters blob put printed

qsm-memory note.description: Write a short-term note for this project, from today, expiring in 14 days; a handoff starts with the task id

args.name: text
args.description: the note

args.name: expires
args.description: days until the note expires (default 14)

args.name: keep
args.description: never expires; drop it by hand

args.name: global
args.description: every project sees it

args.name: drop
args.description: remove the note with this id instead of writing one

qsm-memory notes.description: The current notes for this project and the global ones, newest first, each with its from-date and expiry

args.name: all
args.description: every project's notes

qsm-memory orient.description: The session-start block, at most 1000 characters, built with no model call: this project's last 5 saved sessions, the in-progress tasks and their epics from the task tool, the active notes, and how to search

args.name: cwd
args.description: the directory whose project to brief (default: the working directory)

qsm-memory doctor.description: The health probe: the archive opens, how many sessions and notes it holds, and how many main transcripts on disk it still lacks

qsm-memory mcp.description: Serve search, show, list, notes and note as MCP tools over stdio
